result.analyst_notes: Patient-centred and aspirational, using first-person plural 'we' with absolute language such as 'patients are at the center of everything we do'. Patients lead; employees and community come next. Values are listed in a single 'shared values' sentence. Hedged phrasing appears in 'we aspire' and 'we strive'. Safety is absent.
